title: स्थानीय आर्थिक विकासको वातावरण बनाउन के गर्ने ? {What to do to create an environment for local economic development?}
nepali: यस लेखमा स्थानीय आर्थिक विकासको नीतिगत तथा कार्यक्रमगत प्राथमिकता एवम् सीप विकास तथा सदुपयोगको अवस्था सम्बन्धमा वि सं २०७७ देखि २०७९ को अवधिमा स्थानीय तहका राजनीतिक पदाधिकारी एवम् कर्मचारीहरुसँग गरिएको अलग अलग दुई अध्ययनबाट प्राप्त भएका निष्कर्षहरु समेटिएको छ। दुवै अध्ययनमा अध्ययन विधिको रुपमा समूह छलफल र प्रश्नावलीको प्रयोग भएको छ। अध्ययनबाट प्राप्तनिष्कर्षका आधारमा भन्नुपर्दा फुटकररुपमा विभिन्न कार्यक्रमले स्थानीय आर्थिक विकाससँग सरोकार राखेको देखिएपनि स्पष्ट नीतिगत खाका र संरचनागत पहल भने भएको भेटिएन।त्यस्तै सीपमूलक जनशक्तिको माग र आपूर्तिबीच खाडल छ। यो अध्ययनले स्थानीय आर्थिक विकासको लागि सबै स्थानीय तहहरुले आआफ्नो क्षेत्रमा सम्भावना विश्‍लेषण गरी कृषि, उद्यम विकास र पर्यटन गतिविधिमा सबै पक्षबाट सहयोग जुटाउनुपर्ने निष्कर्ष निकालेको छ भने सीप विकासतर्फ सीपको नक्शाङ्कन गरी व्यवसायिक योजना विकास गर्न समेत सिकाई रोजगारी तथा आय वृद्धिको प्रत्याभूति गर्नुपर्दछ।
american_english: This article compiles the findings obtained from two separate studies conducted between BS 2077 and 2079 with political office bearers and employees of local levels regarding the policy and programmatic priorities of local economic development and the state of skill development and its proper utilization. In both studies, group discussion and questionnaires were used as the study method. On the basis of the findings obtained from the study, it must be said that although various programs are seen to be concerned with local economic development in a piecemeal manner, a clear policy framework and structural initiative were not found. Similarly, there is a gap between the demand and supply of skill-based manpower. This study has drawn the conclusion that, for local economic development, all local levels must analyze potential in their respective areas and mobilize support from all sides in agriculture, enterprise development and tourism activities, and that, on the skill development side, skill mapping must be done and business plans developed, so as to ensure learning, employment and income growth.

informal_english: This article pulls together what came out of two separate studies run between BS 2077 and 2079 with political office holders and staff at the local level, about policy and program priorities for local economic development and where things stand with skill development and making good use of those skills. In both studies, they used group discussions and questionnaires as the method. Based on what the studies found, you have to say that while various programs touch on local economic development in a piecemeal way, there's no clear policy framework or structural initiative to show for it. On top of that, there's a gap between the demand for and supply of skilled manpower. This study concludes that for local economic development, every local level needs to look at its own potential and pull together support from all sides in agriculture, enterprise development and tourism, and on the skill side, do skill mapping and put together business plans, so that learning, jobs and income all grow.
